protocol.selection: Equal positive/negative image strata; random sampling within each stratum
protocol.pretrained: YOLOX-S COCO, OpenCV Zoo; no fine-tuning or threshold tuning on this sample
protocol.ignored: Unmatched detections overlapping Cyclist/Person_sitting by IoU >= 0.5 or DontCare by detection-area overlap > 0.5; duplicates remain false positives
protocol.metric: Fixed-threshold micro precision/recall, not official KITTI AP; equal positive/negative image sampling changes prevalence
protocol.dim_stress: Each BGR intensity multiplied by 0.35 and rounded; synthetic perturbation, not real night-driving data
protocol.latency: Local CPU wall time for preprocessing, inference and postprocessing, 2 OpenCV threads; excludes image I/O and UI; one warm-up excluded

dataset.selection: Equal positive/negative image strata; random sampling within each stratum
